name: safety-guard
description: Blocks destructive shell commands (recursive deletes of root/home, curl | sh, force push, DROP DATABASE, disk writes...) and edits to secrets (.env, keys, .git). Active in auto mode too.
inspiredBy: Claude Code PreToolUse safety hooks (dangerous-command blocker, protected files)

protectedPaths.description: Glob patterns the agent may not write, edit or delete

allowPatterns.description: Regular expressions of commands to always allow (checked first)

extraBlocked.description: Additional regular expressions of commands to block
